Name: Quick Responses (1.6 Updated)
Author: yummypecho
Description:
[b]DESCRIPTION:[/b]

[i]The GOAT of all time [b]Aedenthorn[/b] has officially retired from Stardew Valley modding. Now we are left with remnants of great power and technology--one such is the [b]Quick Responses[/b] mod for most. However, with the dawn of the .6 update, everything has been shattered... [b]NOT! [/b]A lot of the mods only need a bit of tweaking to work as smoothly as it did before![/i]

[s][ Meant for personal use but it's here now. ][/s]

I'm very young in this modding community and really just wanted to get this mod to work since it served me so much in my last playthrough. I tweaked the code a bit (some maybe unnecessary), yet the only real change I needed to do was to change List<Response> into [b]Response[ ][/b]. Nevertheless, I kept the unnecessary tweakings, as they should only help make the mod crash less in theory. 

Haven't stress tested (or whatnot-), and did this in [u]SDV 1.6.1 + SMAPI 4.0.1[/u] , so do let me know if crashes or performance issues persist. Thanks. ^^

Forked code: [b][url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/shankencedric/StardewValleyMods-aedenthorn[/url] [/b](this repo might not work since I made a different one before this where I actually worked).

- yummypecho




[b]ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION: [/b]
This mod lets you select the first response in two-response questions by pressing a configurable key ("[G]" by default).

It also lets you select any response in a question by pressing the number key corresponding to its rank in the list, and show numbers beside the responses to guide you.

You can turn off the numbers or change their colour in the config.json file (created when you first run).
[b]
[/b]Requires[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], does not use Harmony.
